question_en: Which internal and external issues affect the bribery risks of the organisation?
question_id: Isu internal dan eksternal mana yang memengaruhi risiko penyuapan organisasi?

question_en: Show how this bribery risk was assessed, by position, transaction or business associate.
question_id: Tunjukkan bagaimana risiko penyuapan ini dinilai, berdasarkan posisi, transaksi atau mitra bisnis.

question_en: Which control addresses this bribery risk, and is it proportionate?
question_id: Kontrol mana yang menangani risiko penyuapan ini, dan apakah kontrol itu proporsional?

question_en: Was due diligence done on this position or business associate, and is it current?
question_id: Apakah uji tuntas sudah dilakukan atas posisi atau mitra bisnis ini, dan apakah masih berlaku?

question_en: Where is the control written down, and is that version current?
question_id: Di mana kontrol ini didokumentasikan, dan apakah versinya masih berlaku?

question_en: Show records that the control operated in this cycle.
question_id: Tunjukkan rekaman bahwa kontrol ini berjalan pada siklus ini.
